messages:
Alex: Heads up — pricing/packaging sync. We need to lock the upgrade path and usage guardrails for GA. Who owns the numbers/UX/contract knobs? cc @Maya @Ben
Maya: Quick take — we should standardize on: soft alerts -> soft caps/throttles -> paid overage or forced upgrade. Keep free tier simple.
Ben: Agree. Also recommend a 'burst credits' add-on for Pro so brief spikes don't trigger churn. :thumbsup:
Samir: From legal/contracts: enterprise customers will ask for seat/group caps and buy blocks. We need an MSA clause for custom caps + prepay/commit credits. Overages are negotiable at enterprise scale.
Rachel: Launch criteria reminder: docs + console UX for quota display, clear overage math, telemetry for 95th/99th pct, and migration path for customers who hit caps. No GA without telemetry hooks.
Alex: Numbers sketch (for discussion): Free=50k tokens/mo, Pro=1M, Business=10M, Enterprise=custom. Overage unit price? maybe $2 per 1M tokens for Business band, $3 for Pro band, and negotiated for Enterprise. Thoughts?
Maya: rough prototype snippet for billing rules: ```
tiers = [
  {"name":"Free","tokens":50000,"overage":0,"action":"throttle"},
  {"name":"Pro","tokens":1000000,"overage":0.002,"action":"bill"},
  {"name":"Business","tokens":10000000,"overage":0.0015,"action":"bill"}
]
```
Maya: Note: set Free to throttle not bill, to avoid surprise charges.
Ben: Throttle for Free makes sense. For Pro we could offer 1M tokens + optional 100k burst credits add-on at signup. UI should show remaining burst balance.
Samir: Contract knobs: add-on blocks (e.g., 10M token block for $X), prepay credits, and SLA add-on. Also include a 'soft cap' mode: send 7/3/1 day warnings -> automatic throttle -> sales alert.
Rachel: Metric to recommend upgrade: customer exceeds 80% of tier for 14 consecutive days OR sustained 95th pct spikes. We should instrument normalized tokens/day per org.
Alex: Rollout plan: 1) internal beta with friendly customers (2 weeks), 2) opt-in trial for paying customers (4 weeks), 3) GA in US, then EU. Need feature flags for throttle vs bill behaviors.
Ben: UX tasks: console banner, modal to purchase add-on, and emails for billing/soft-cap. I'll mock the flows.
Maya: Also need evals to confirm unit economics: how much batching/cache reduces per-token cost at each tier. If we recommend quantization on lower-priced tiers, document model-quality tradeoffs.
Samir: Legal will draft MSA language for add-ons + a short 'pricing appendix' template for sales to modify. We should avoid open-ended overage ambiguity.
Rachel: Observability items: expose per-org token rate, 95/99 pct, burst credit usage, and overage events to Console + Alerting. I'll add to roadmap.
Alex: Action items: Maya -> PRD bullets + sample prices by EOD Friday; Ben -> console mocks by next Wed; Samir -> MSA appendix draft by next Tue; Rachel -> telemetry/events list by Fri. Aim for beta in 6 weeks.
PricingBot: New pricing experiment created: experiment_id=exp_20260315_01 (created by @Alex)
Maya: SGTM :rocket:
Ben: LGTM — will include copy for in-app warnings.
Samir: Noted. I'll include negotiation language for caps and prepay buffers.
Rachel: I'll add alert thresholds and dashboard panels to the ticket.
Alex: Thanks all — we'll sync again after PRD updates.
